amended_contract.acquisition_stop_rule: scan all 39 frozen quiet candidates; do not stop after the first 12 availability-complete dates
amended_contract.candidate_order: all frozen final_holdout quiet dates in ascending quiet_rank
amended_contract.rejected_date_policy: preserve every rejected candidate and its technical reason
amended_contract.retention_rule: retain every candidate date for which all six frozen stations have three valid 200-Hz integer miniSEED components and at least 0.95 common component availability

amendment_uses_only: frozen quiet-date candidate count and order

next_boundary: This amendment does not unlock final data. Final waveform acquisition remains prohibited until the C0/C1 arm and event threshold are frozen from temporal-development scores.

parent_contract.selection_rule: Download in quiet-rank order and retain the first target prefix with complete parseable three-component coverage. Availability QC must finish before any scoring.

statistical_design.endpoint: three-station quiet-background network confirmations per connected network exposure day
statistical_design.reason_for_amendment: increase prospective background exposure and tighten the Poisson rate interval before any final waveform access
statistical_design.reporting_rule: compute the interval from measured connected-network exposure; do not substitute retained date count for exposure
